question: With pinned Mistral-7B frozen and the world facts given only as a separately encoded memory, does a v5 lattice over the memory and question states feeding v4's gated logit residual answer from the memory, so that the twin's facts flip the affected held-out answers?
data_checks: V19 symbolic-oracle labels, affected pattern, label balance and split audit; data file hashes

rendering.check: both sides render the same prompt (V15 LiveStore)

memory.states: host residual stream at memory_boundary (engine DecoderHost.to_cut), bfloat16: V19's writer input

features.question_states: DecoderHost.to_cut(question, memory_boundary) at every prompt position (bfloat16)
features.base_logits: native logits of the two candidates at the last prompt position
features.parity: per question row, the frozen head on the final states and the decoder continued from the cut both reproduce the full native logits bitwise
features.memory_states: DecoderHost.to_cut(memory text, memory_boundary) at every position (bfloat16)

route.composition: latent_workspace.composition.DeliberationRoute with deferred memory: each row's memory states packed before its question states
route.initialization: per-component derived seeds; the arms of one seed share every parameter

arm_definitions.memory: every training row reads its own side's facts as memory
arm_definitions.query_only: the same route and rows without memory

training.objective: choice-normalized cross-entropy over the two candidates at the last prompt position
training.randomness: data order per epoch, dropout and loss sampling per update, all derived from (seed, step)
training.rows: train split, both sides x 8 questions = 4,096 rows

endpoints.learning_check: the same rule on the train split (512 affected questions; intact, twin and random-pair memory): a seed that fails it is NOT_LEARNED
endpoints.overall: CONTENT_REACHES_ANSWERS if every seed reaches it; DIRECTIONAL_ONLY if every seed is at least directional; NOT_LEARNED if no seed learned; otherwise NOT_ESTABLISHED

process_policy: each role a fresh process through scripts/run_source_sealed.py, in order, stopping at the first failure
scope: Frozen backbone. A pass shows that the system (host plus workspace) answers from a memory the host never saw with the question, on held-out worlds of this task family; not that memory moves the native head, nor general reasoning, non-regression or language quality.
